speaker: Doctor
text: Given the combination of a continuous heart murmur, bluish non-blanching skin macules, cloudy lenses, and hearing loss in a newborn with no prenatal care, these findings are highly suggestive of congenital rubella syndrome. speaker: Doctor
text: The positive Rubella IgM, patent ductus arteriosus, congenital cataracts, and bilateral sensorineural hearing loss in a newborn with no prenatal care confirm the diagnosis of Congenital Rubella Syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome
